**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole fruit uses the fruit density of 0.6 g/ml. 286 ml × 0.6 ≈ 172 g. This matches a typical medium apple.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Apple ≈ 52 kcal/100 g. 172 g × 0.52 ≈ 89 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A medium apple weighs about 150–180 g and has about 80–95 kcal, so the estimate is plausible. The crumbs add negligible weight.
